_description: Bridges LoRa remote nodes to MQTT master node (Mac/PC)
_architecture: Remote Nodes (LoRa) → Gateway Pi → MQTT → Master Node (Mac)

lora._frequency_comment: 915 MHz for US/Canada. Use 868 for Europe, 433 for Asia

mqtt._broker_comment: IP address of Mac/PC running master node

_hardware.gateway_pi: Raspberry Pi Zero W + LoRa HAT ($60 total)
_hardware.antenna: Included with LoRa HAT - mount vertically

_setup_steps: 1. Install LoRa HAT on Raspberry Pi Zero W
3. Update 'broker' IP to your Mac's IP address
5. Optional: Set up systemd service for auto-start

_troubleshooting.no_mqtt_connection: Check Mac IP address and firewall (allow port 1883)
_troubleshooting.check_logs: Gateway shows RSSI/SNR for each LoRa packet received
